integrity: Proof, exact-rational witness and executable symbolic checks included; scientific priority is qualified and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional SPD quadratics; Cauchy seed followed by a single curvature-feedback step. Asymptotic sharp leading coefficient, not an exact fixed-condition-number supremum. Earlier geometric-mean spectral method is not new; 2015 primary chapter inaccessible for theorem-level comparison.
title: Sharp high-conditioning two-step objective gain for Cauchy-seeded curvature feedback
